card.name: Inside quoted idioms and set phrases
card.fires_on: Words inside a quoted or fixed idiom, such as 'find their own level', 'well-informed' or 'cognitive heavy lifting', mostly in general web prose. It also fires on the opening quote mark and on the middle of rarer compounds.

modes.label: Quoted idiom
modes.description: A word or opening quote inside a phrase set off in single quotes.
modes.example: We offer opportunities for individuals to ‘<<find>> their own level’; to dip in

modes.label: Fixed phrase middle
modes.description: A word partway through a set phrase or compound, before its expected ending.
modes.example: think that we’re the only ones in the building doing this kind of cognitive<< heavy>> lifting.

modes.label: Split rare word
modes.description: The first piece of a rare word that is split into parts.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of familiar sayings and quoted phrases, where the next word is almost fixed.
